description: HIFLD OPEN Dam Lines (USACE IENC) is a data set deposited in Harvard Dataverse by its authors U.S. Army Corps of Engineers, United States Department of Homeland Security. The USACE IENCs coverage area consists of 7,260 miles across 21 rivers primarily located in the Central United States. IENCs apply to inland waterways that are maintained for navigation by USACE for shallow-draft vessels (e.g., maintained at a depth of 9-14 feet, dependent upon the waterway project authorization). Coverage: national (US); the metadata date the deposit to 2025. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is not stated (no licence in the Dataverse metadata read on 2026-09-29). Caveats: written from the Dataverse search and dataset metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support water-network, drainage and hydraulic studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-hdv-repository.
